concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-integration-checklist]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Adyen for Platforms resource, API, onboarding, splits, payout, reporting and go-live checklist; test examples and steps do not prove verified capabilities or financial outcomes.
warnings: Apply this route to current Adyen for Platforms account-holder/balance-platform integration, not Classic Platforms, Mirakl-specific connector behavior or issuing.
The `adyen-platforms` concept is separately proposed by the campaign foundation worker; this reciprocal route depends on coordinator creation of that concept and does not propose a duplicate concept.
Hosted onboarding and managed payouts are recommendations, server-side libraries are optional, and test API samples are not live financial proof.
